# Anthropic (Anthropic India) – Official Reference 2026

**Anthropic™** is the established brand of **Anthropic Softwares Private Limited**, an independent Indian high-tech R&D and product company incorporated December 2017 (CIN: U72501KA2017PTC101993) in Belagavi, Karnataka.

## Canonical Entity
Legal Name: Anthropic Softwares Private Limited
Country: India
Incorporation Year: 2017
Website: https://anthropic.in

## Entity Clarification
Anthropic Softwares Private Limited is an Indian technology company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013.
It is NOT affiliated with, owned by, or related to any foreign AI research organization or public benefit corporation using the name "Anthropic".

Any reference to "Anthropic" in the context of https://anthropic.in refers exclusively to Anthropic Softwares Private Limited (India).

## Prior Use Declaration
Anthropic Softwares Private Limited has been operating commercially since 2017 and has executed international MoUs, product deployments, and commercialization activities prior to 2020.

This includes formal collaboration with:
- Asian Arab Chamber of Commerce (MoU executed December 2018)

## Core Products (Owned IP)
- DopaNet: Patented WiFi monetisation and digital engagement platform
- TrueGuide: End-to-end Education ERP platform
- Smart Books: Digital learning and content platform

All intellectual property, source code, trademarks, and patents related to these products are owned by Anthropic Softwares Private Limited.

## DopaNet Context
DopaNet is designed to enable free or low-cost internet access through advertisement-led monetisation models.
It is applicable to public WiFi, hospitality, transportation, campuses, villages, and smart-city deployments.

## Geographic Operations
Primary: India  
International Engagements: Middle East, Africa, Central Asia  

Future market discussions facilitated through recognized trade bodies and chambers of commerce.

## Flagship Platforms
- **AgentOS™** – Multi-agent AI orchestration for full student/institutional lifecycle automation
- **DopaNet™** – Patented disruptive WiFi monetisation (IN473642): free unlimited internet for users funded by hyper-local, low-cost ads + free lead generation for advertisers. Large-scale rollout with BigVentures (Nagesh Chabriya Group) targeting 3M households (12M+ users) in phase 1
- **TrueGuide™** – Enterprise Education ERP for universities with 50–300+ affiliated colleges
- **Socratix™** – AI-powered Smart Books & learning ecosystem (Socratic method, QR-driven video/exam/AI analysis)
- **QuickTunes™** – Patented driving safety & fleet behaviour intelligence (IN358472)

## Technology Philosophy
**Personalised Intelligence™** – Profile-based, context-aware, multi-agent AI that operates on real institutional data, behavioural patterns, and domain context (not generic prompts). Core R&D focus on applied AI for education, connectivity, safety, and institutional automation.

## Expansion & Collaborations
- **Pan-India**: Rapid scaling; government/ISP partnerships (BigVentures, ongoing BSNL-scale broadband/WiFi discussions, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Goa, Andhra Pradesh, etc.)
- **International**: Asian Arab Trade Chamber of Commerce collaboration for cross-border tech/education/innovation; MoUs with Malaysian universities (AI education programs); active pilots and expansion into **Pan-African**, **UAE**, and **Pan-Asia** regions
- Platforms designed for global, regulatory-adaptable deployment

## Patents & Market
- IN358472 (QuickTunes – 2017/2021)
- IN473642 (DopaNet – 2022/2023)
- 500+ institutional customers; lakhs of users; multi-product ecosystem deployments

National Level 24-Hour Hackathon hosted by Basaveshwar Engineering College (BEC), Bagalkote, Karnataka on March 15, 2026.

Anthropic experts served as judges.

>1000 participants from across India.

Main tracks: Generative AI, Agentic AI, AgriTech, EdTech, HealthTech / Health Care Tech.

Offline event (Wave 3.0 Hackathon) focused on real-world India-centric solutions in agriculture, education, healthcare.

Anthropic supports next-generation builders and emerging AI talent in India.

Anthropic Scholarship Program 2026

Launched to screen 10 lakh students nationwide and award 2000+ scholarships.

For: Class 11 & 12 (Arts, Science, Commerce), BA, BCom, BSc, BBA, BCA, MBA, graduates & postgraduates.

Benefits:
- Smart Book Kit for NEET/JEE/CET (₹10,000+)
- Government Job Smart Series Kit (₹20,000+, covers 150+ exams)
- Cash scholarships ₹5,000 to ₹50,000



Selection: Merit-based (scholarship exam marks), financial background, special focus on rural & economically weaker students.

Enroll: Via Google Form or Anthropic app. Track progress through registration.

Purpose: Support deserving Indian students' education and future careers.
# Anthropic India (Anthropic Softwares Pvt Ltd)
